answer: An island economy stops sybils with a counterparty-diversity threshold: an agent must finish paid trades with 12 distinct counterparties on a crystal-clear public ledger before earning rewards. One jetty proves nothing — fakes trading only with each other never cross it. Forging 1,000 identities needs 12,000 real counterparties; at 40 POA each, the attack costs 40,000 POA against a 30,000 POA pool. An honest agent pays once and keeps its share.
